macros.name: OTSTUP
macros.doc: \OTSTUP is a hook for indentation of first two kinds of comments. By default it is 2 em, but one can easily redefine it.

macros.name: SHRIFTN
macros.doc: \SHRIFTZ and \SHRIFTN are two hooks which are defined by default as \relax (do nothing), so one can redefine them to change the representation of these number and end-level objects, respectively.

macros.name: SHRIFTZ
macros.doc: \SHRIFTZ and \SHRIFTN are two hooks which are defined by default as \relax (do nothing), so one can redefine them to change the representation of these number and end-level objects, respectively.

macros.name: TT
macros.doc: \T and \TT are just the same thing, but second is better to designate names, and first is better for numbers.

macros.name: VT
macros.doc: Command \VT is for hanging number references.

macros.name: VT*
macros.doc: Command \VT is for hanging number references.
